status: No expert ratings yet: recommendation accuracy is NOT measured. The figures below are automatic checks of grounding, agreement and stability, plus a backtest of the growth factor.

queries.selection: hash-ranked corpus papers first submitted in 2026 (seed 44); each query paper is excluded from its own neighbours and supporting papers

temporal_backtest_of_growth_signal.question: Did topic pairs that grew from 2016-17 to 2020-21 keep growing to 2024-25?
temporal_backtest_of_growth_signal.note: Tests only whether the growth factor carries information about later growth; it is not a test of whether a suggested direction is a real research gap.
